pr_title: [maglev] Inline String.p.charAt with one-byte constant folding
pr_description: Inline String.prototype.charAt in Maglev and add similar constant folding for string element access. Fold single-character results only for one-byte codes backed by roots; return an empty MaybeReduceResult for two-byte codes so the existing runtime path handles them.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

fix_commit_message:
[maglev] Bail out of two-byte one-char string constant from code

Allocating a new two-byte one-char string inline for constant two-byte
string access is problematic given how heap refs work, so just bail out
of the constant folding there.

Fixed: 416833098
Change-Id: Ibbbb086e117562a95e53ed677dd2ac9898efd7a8

agent_reasoning: Creating a two-byte single-character string during constant folding allocates on the local isolate heap and can violate the broker's heap-reference invariants. The helper now returns MaybeReduceResult, retains root-backed one-byte constants, and declines two-byte constant folding without allocating a string or constructing a heap reference. Only the helper implementation and declaration were edited; validation confirmed the resulting PR applies cleanly against intro_parent.
